'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
***[[Gaza war|Israel–Hamas war]]
****[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
*****The [[Palestine Liberation Organization]] says that [[Israel]] refused a request to bring food and medical supplies into the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-refuses-request-bring-food-medical-supplies-into-gaza-palestinian-plo-2023-10-10 (Reuters)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/hamas-says-at-least-30-people-killed-in-overnight-strikes/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*****Gaza's only power plant stops producing power due to a lack of fuel, thereby threatening to further impact over-capacity medical facilities. Authorities begin rationing and directing power to emergency services. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/11/middleeast/gaza-power-plant-shuts-down-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*****The [[UNRWA|UN Palestine Agency]] says that Israeli airstrikes have killed eleven of its staff in Gaza, with four [[Palestine Red Crescent Society]] paramedics and one [[Magen David Adom]] ambulance driver also being killed in clashes. The agency also says that it has less than two weeks' supply of food and water available to assist the more than 180,000 people who have sought refuge in their schools in Gaza. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/nine-staffers-working-with-un-palestinian-refugee-agency-killed-air-strikes-gaza-2023-10-11/ (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/11/gaza-faces-humanitarian-catastrophe-as-sole-power-plant-runs-out-of-fuel (Al Jazeera)]
****Dozens of [[Israeli Air Force]] warplanes carry out more than 200 [[airstrike]]s overnight on the Al-Furqan neighborhood in [[Gaza City]]. The [[Rimal]] and al-Karama neighbourhoods are also targeted by airstrikes, with eight 12-storey buildings destroyed. At least 30 people are killed and hundreds more are injured. [https://www.firstpost.com/world/israeli-jets-hit-over-200-targets-in-overnight-strikes-in-gaza-terror-nest-says-idf-13231652.html (First Post)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/2023/10/11/photos-rimal-neighbourhood-the-beating-heart-of-gaza-wiped-out (Al Jazeera)] [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/israel-strikes-neighborhood-after-neighborhood-gaza-war-appears-103883379 (ABC News)] [https://www.tasnimnews.com/en/news/2023/10/11/2969995/8-towers-destroyed-as-israeli-attacks-level-gaza-neighborhoods (Tasnim)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/hamas-says-at-least-30-people-killed-in-overnight-strikes/ (''Times of Israel'')]
****Israeli airstrikes destroy more than 22,600 residential units and 10 health facilities and also damage 48 schools as [[Hamas]] continues to fire rockets from civilian areas in violation of international law. At least 260 children have been killed by Israeli attacks on Gaza. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/israel-hamas-gaza-war-1.6992321 (CBC News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/11/how-are-children-in-gaza-affected-by-the-israel-hamas-war (Al Jazeera)]
****At least 16 [[Palestinians]] are killed in an Israeli air raid on the southern city of [[Khan Younis]] and at least three Palestinians are killed and nine others are injured by Israeli soldiers in the [[Qusra]] south of [[Nablus]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/mena/palestine-israel/2023/10/11/live-israel-gaza-war/?outputType=amp (The National News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gaza-war-rages-israeli-forces-kill-27-palestinians-west-bank-2023-10-11/ (Reuters)]
****At least 1,055 [[Palestine|Palestinians]] have been killed in Israeli air attacks and 5,184 others have been injured, according to the [[Gaza Health Ministry]]. At least 1,300 people in Israel have been killed and 2,800 others have been injured, according to the [[Israeli Defense Force|Israeli military]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-prepares-ground-offensive-biden-pledges-support-after-hamas-attacks-2023-10-10/ (Reuters)]
****[[Germany]] approves an Israeli request to use two of its [[IAI Heron]] combat drones in strikes on the Gaza Strip. [https://www.reuters.com/world/germany-clears-use-two-heron-tp-combat-drones-by-israel-spiegel-2023-10-11/ (Reuters)]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***Three [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] civilians are injured in [[Israel Defense Force|IDF]] and [[Hezbollah]] clashes near [[Tyre, Lebanon]]. [https://www.newarab.com/news/more-1000-killed-israeli-blitz-gaza-strip (New Arab)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Herat earthquakes]]
**A magnitude 6.3 [[aftershock]] strikes near the [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] city of [[Herat]], killing at least one person and injuring 65 others just four days after two earthquakes of the same magnitude struck the same area, killing thousands of people. [https://da.azadiradio.com/a/32632288.html (Radio Azadi)]
*Flights are suspended at [[Luton Airport]] in [[Bedfordshire]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]], after a fire occurs in a [[multistorey car park]] at the airport. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-england-beds-bucks-herts-67075159 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–China relations]]
**[[China]] deports [[Australians|Australian]] journalist [[Cheng Lei (journalist)|Cheng Lei]] following over three years of detention and a conviction on espionage charges. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/10/12/world/asia-oceania/china-frees-journalist-imprisoned-for-3-years/1914352 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[Dominican Republic–Haiti relations]]
**The [[Dominican Republic]] partially reopens [[Dominican Republic–Haiti border|its border]] with [[Haiti]] for some [[commerce|commercial]] activity after closing the border last month. [https://apnews.com/article/dominican-republic-haiti-border-reopens-canal-dispute-9c829919039f09e5f0d01e1acdd77f5a (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Gaza war protests|Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**[[Law enforcement in Austria|Police]] in [[Vienna]], [[Austria]], announce that they have banned a [[Palestinian nationalism|pro-Palestinian]] [[Israel–Hamas war protests|protest]] over mentions of "[[from the river to the sea]]" in invitations and the characterization of the protest as a call for violence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/from-river-sea-prompts-vienna-ban-pro-palestinian-protest-2023-10-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israeli war cabinet]]
***[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and opposition leader [[Benny Gantz]] agree to form an [[Provisional government|emergency government]] during the war. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-middle-east-67073970 (BBC News)]
*[[2023 Slovak parliamentary election]]
**[[Direction – Social Democracy|Smer]] leader [[Robert Fico]] agrees to form a [[coalition government]] with the [[left-wing politics|left-wing]] [[Voice – Social Democracy|Hlas]] and [[ultranationalism|ultranationalist]] [[Slovak National Party]], paving the way for Fico to become [[Prime Minister of Slovakia]] for a fourth time. [https://www.euronews.com/2023/10/11/slovakia-populist-fico-strikes-deal-with-pro-russia-party-to-form-coalition-government (Euronews)]

**[[Republican Party (United States)|Republicans]] in the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House]] nominate [[Steve Scalise]] to replace [[Kevin McCarthy]] as [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/republican-steve-scalise-path-us-house-speaker-turbulent-time-2023-10-11/ (Reuters)]
